help: Local data partition owned by this node. Use a new namespace for a different seed dataset.
label: Local namespace

help: Allowed object types, such as inventory or orders. No external ERP is contacted.
label: Allowed object types

help: Canonical output field → source field. Flat exact keys only; source IDs are never editable.
label: Field mapping

help: Canonical fields accepted by exact reference matching. Multiple matches remain visible.
label: Reference matching fields

help: Allow explicitly approved changes to this node’s local dataset only. Off by default.
label: Enable approved local updates

help: Canonical fields that may be proposed for updates. Keep empty for read-only operation.
label: Editable fields

help: Initial array of {object_type, source_id, data}. Imported once on first request; never overwrites edited records. No secrets.
label: Initial local dataset

help: Validity of an exact update proposal in seconds. Expiry never triggers a change.
label: Proposal validity (seconds)

help: Maximum seed records per partition. There is no implicit ERP synchronization.
label: Record limit

help: Retained proposals per partition. Replay protection is never silently pruned; full storage refuses new proposals.
label: Retained proposal limit

help: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per request or normalized record. Total seed size is separately limited to 4 MiB.
label: Request / record limit (bytes)
